verdict.rationale: The GST help pages document a pre-account entry path. A taxpayer can register or 'generate a User ID on temporary basis', and registration is a two-part (Part A / Part B) flow, which implies a founder starts registration before holding portal credentials. The snippets never say outright that no login is needed, and return filing appears to sit behind the documented login flow. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that Part A starts without an account, documentation of the temporary/reference-number entry path, a keyless path for the filing flow itself, and hands-on corroboration.
